title: Neon Loom
description: A weaver pilots a shuttle through a glowing loom of light-threads, cutting stray threads that tangle into knots. The shuttle drifts with momentum, and each cut thread unravels a knot worth points.
body:
A weaver pilots a shuttle through a glowing loom of light-threads, cutting stray threads that tangle into knots. The shuttle drifts with momentum, and each cut thread unravels a knot worth points.

The rules are simple: the ship drifts with momentum on a 20 by 16 grid, thrusting, turning, and firing at 5 drifting rocks. Large rocks split into smaller ones when shot, and the run ends when every rock is cleared or the ship collides three times.

Knots drift and split when cut, so the weaver cuts the largest knot first and lets fragments drift apart before chasing them. A clean cut scores double, while a tangled shuttle loses a thread of its own.
controls: Type thrust/left/right/shoot to fly and fire, quit to stop.

body:
Gardeners tend a garden of light-beams, pruning beam-weeds that choke the garden's glow. The gardener's ship fires pruning-pulses, and each pruned weed drops a seed-beam worth points.

The rules are simple: the ship drifts with momentum on a 20 by 16 grid, thrusting, turning, and firing at 4 drifting rocks. Large rocks split into smaller ones when shot, and the run ends when every rock is cleared or the ship collides three times.

Beam-weeds choke the brightest beams first, so the gardeners guard the brightest bed hardest. A seed-beam planted in a cleared bed grows a new beam that lights the whole garden.
controls: Type thrust/left/right/shoot to fly and fire, quit to stop.
